name: fuzzy_match_strategy_trimmed_boundary
notes: Traced copy of fuzzy_match_helpers.c::fuzzy_match_strategy_trimmed_boundary vs LIVE tools/fuzzy_match.py::_strategy_trimmed_boundary, scoped to SINGLE-LINE patterns. REAL PARITY GAP (documented, not gated): the C port strips EVERY line of the pattern and each candidate block, while LIVE strips only the first and last lines — on multi-line patterns the two find different match sets (e.g. a middle line's indentation is preserved by LIVE but trimmed by C). The gate pins the np==1 slice where trimming-all equals trimming-first, so the traced rungs agree; twin cross-asserts its computed matches against the LIVE call per input.
